create_oauth_session: create an OAuth session by calling OAuthSessions.create_session with user_id, provider, and token dict
get_oauth_session_by_id: get an OAuth session by ID using OAuthSessions.get_session_by_id
get_oauth_sessions_by_user: get all OAuth sessions for a user using OAuthSessions.get_sessions_by_user_id
update_oauth_session: update OAuth session tokens using OAuthSessions.update_session_by_id with session_id and new token dict
delete_oauth_session: delete an OAuth session by ID using OAuthSessions.delete_session_by_id
